EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT

This agreement is entered into between Acme Corp and John Smith (john.smith@example.com, 415-555-2671).

1. At-will employment. Either party may terminate this agreement at any time.
2. Non-compete. Employee agrees not to work for a competitor within 50 miles for 2 years after termination.
3. Confidentiality. Employee agrees to keep all company information confidential indefinitely.
4. Compensation. Employee will be paid $85,000 annually, reviewed yearly.
